menu:Clip/clip.makeSubclip.note: Opens upstream's Make Subclip (clip_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clipStructure.ts): Name, Start and End in media frames each with its timecode, and Restrict Trims, on what the engine would subclip (subclip_defaults through dialogDefaults). Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: project (the subclip row with its icon).

menu:Clip/clip.editSubclip.note: Opens upstream's Edit Subclip: the Project selection's first subclip (its name shown), Start and End in its parent's media frames, Restrict Trims, and Convert to Master Clip (dialogDefaults). Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: project.

menu:Clip/clip.editOffline.note: Opens upstream's Edit Offline File (menu_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clipStructure.ts): Media Name, Tape Name, Description, Scene, Shot/Take, and Log Note of the Project selection's first item (dialogDefaults). Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: project.

menu:Clip/clip.sourceSettings.note: Opens upstream's Source Settings (menu_dialogs.rs): the codec and the engine's message (the clip.sourceSettings query; when it fails the dialog does not open and the error goes to the status bar, as upstream's `?`), with one OK, which carries control:dialog.ok (upstream's sourceSettings.ok). It shows information; nothing to preview (preview kind none).

menu:Clip/Modify/clip.audioChannels.note: Opens upstream's Modify Clip: Audio Channels (clip_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clipStructureBodies.tsx): for a project item the Clip Channel Format radios, the Number of Audio Clips, and the clip x source channel matrix (clips: [[ch]]); for timeline clips the source channels they play (channels). Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: timeline and project.

menu:Clip/Modify/clip.interpretFootage.note: Opens upstream's Interpret Footage (color_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clip.ts, clipBodies.tsx) on the given items, the Project selection, or the selected clips' items: the detected space (media.colorInfo), Use file metadata or a colour space (color.spaces), the first item's override chosen; with a colorSpace it runs at once. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: picture and project. Deviation: when OK's command fails, upstream closes the dialog and reports the error in the status bar; Kition keeps the dialog open with the error in it (Task 9's rule for every dialog).

menu:Clip/Modify/clip.modifyTimecode.note: Opens upstream's Modify Clip: Timecode: Set Timecode, Tape Name, and Use the file's timecode (which drops the timecode, finish()), on the Project selection's first media item (dialogDefaults). Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: project (the Media Start cell).

menu:Clip/Video Options/clip.frameHoldOp.note: Opens upstream's Frame Hold Options (clip_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clip.ts) on the first selected clip's hold (dialogDefaults): Hold On, In/Out Point, Playhead, Source Timecode, Sequence Time (with its Timecode), Hold Filters; OK drops the timecode as finish() does. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: picture.

menu:Clip/Video Options/clip.fieldOption.note: Opens upstream's Field Options (clip_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clip.ts): Reverse Field Dominance and the processing radios, upstream's defaults. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: picture.

menu:Clip/Audio Options/clip.audioGain.note: Opens upstream's Audio Gain (dialogs.rs audio_gain; dialogs/clip.ts, clipBodies.tsx): the four modes with their dB (-96 to 96, one decimal), Peak Amplitude from clip.audioPeak per revision, the draft kept for the next time (app.ui), Adjust first; OK sends {mode, db}. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: sound (the strip's Play) and the peak after the gain beside the current one. Deviation: when OK's command fails, upstream closes the dialog and reports the error in the status bar; Kition keeps the dialog open with the error in it (Task 9's rule for every dialog).

menu:Clip/clip.speedDuration.note: Opens upstream's Clip Speed / Duration (clip_dialogs.rs; dialogs/clip.ts): Speed with the Duration readout, Reverse Speed (also on for a reversed clip, Task 9's recorded deviation), Ripple, the time interpolation preselected. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: picture and timeline.

menu:Clip/clip.sceneEditDetection.note: Opens upstream's Scene Edit Detection (menu_dialogs.rs defaults/show/run; dialogs/menu.ts), OK "Analyze": Apply a cut, Create a subclip, and Generate clip markers at each detected cut point (applyCuts on, the others off) and Sensitivity (0 to 100, 50; upstream's Slider, a number field with its scrub here). OK sends upstream's params {applyCuts, createSubclips, generateMarkers, sensitivity} for the timeline's selected video clips; with nothing chosen it previews nothing and OK shows the engine's "choose at least one". Analyze closes the dialog with upstream's status "Scene Edit Detection: analysing in the background (see Progress)": on the web, which has no threads, the document's own job runs a step at a time (Session::step_jobs) as upstream's thread does, advanced each animation frame (jobsStep: pump_jobs, then poll_persistence), its progress and Cancel in the status bar (upstream's job_status), and its result lands as one "Scene Edit Detection" history step, recorded in the replica; the Progress panel is Task 37's. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: a job on the scratch session, a stepped job the engine advances for 12 ms each animation frame (previewSettle, progress in the strip; previewEnd on Cancel stops it), its cuts on the Timeline, subclips and their bin in the Project panel, and clip markers on the Source monitor's bar when the clip's media is open there (else in the strip) once it ends.

menu:Clip/clip.nest.note: Opens upstream's Nested Sequence Name: the name, focused as it opens (the engine's next free Nested Sequence NN), Enter is OK. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: timeline (one nest clip in place of the selection) and project (the new sequence row). The engine's Nest at 23.976 fps no longer overlaps the next clip.

Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: picture (the new frame size at its aspect, scale motion) and timeline (the ruler and timecode at the new timebase and display format).

menu:Sequence/sequence.addTracks.note: Opens upstream's Add Tracks (dialogs.rs add_tracks; dialogs/tracks.ts): video, audio, and submix groups with Amount (0–99), Placement (Before First Track or after a track; greyed with no track of the kind), and Track type (audio, submix); opens on one video and one audio track after the last ones. menu:Sequence/sequence.deleteTracks.note: Opens upstream's Delete Tracks (dialogs.rs delete_tracks; dialogs/tracks.ts): Delete Video Tracks and Delete Audio Tracks, each with All Empty Tracks or a track (V1, A2…); OK is greyed until one is checked and sends only those; no confirmation, as upstream. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: timeline (the tracks that go, struck through).

menu:Sequence/sequence.colorSettings.note: Opens upstream's Sequence Color Management (color_dialogs.rs open_sequence; dialogs/sequence.ts): the working colour space radios, wide gamut, and Auto tone map media of the active sequence; OK sends sequence.colorSettings {workingSpace, wideGamut, autoToneMap}, one history step (none when nothing changed). menu:Clip/clip.updateMetadata.note: Opens upstream's Update Metadata (menu_dialogs.rs; dialogs/menu.ts), its own confirmation (rule 6): "Write the metadata of the selected clip(s) (n) to XMP files next to their media?" (n the larger of the Project and timeline selections) and that XMP files other applications wrote are left unchanged; OK runs clip.updateMetadata {} for the selection, as upstream. It writes outside the project (PREVIEW_EXTERNAL), so it never runs on the scratch session: its preview is a summary (kind summary) listing each clip whose XMP file OK writes (upstream's targets: the Project selection, else the timeline's clips' items).

menu:Clip/clip.synchronize.note: Opens upstream's Synchronize Clips (multicam.rs show_dialog; dialogs/clipStructureBodies.tsx): the clip count, the Synchronize Point (In, Out, Timecode with Ignore Hours, Clip Marker with its name, Audio), Offset in frames, and Reference track; OK sends upstream's params exactly (method, offset, ignoreHours, marker and track when typed); the engine syncs the timeline's selection, which the preview follows. menu:Clip/clip.mergeClips.note: Opens upstream's Merge Clips (multicam.rs show_dialog): Clip Name ("<first> - Merged"), the Project selection's clips, the Synchronize Point, Offset Audio by, and Remove Audio from AV Clip; OK sends items, method, offset, ignoreHours, removeVideoAudio, and marker and name when typed. Upstream's dialog has no preview; Film previews it: project (the merged item row).

menu:Clip/Proxy/media.attachProxies.note: Picks a video file through the host for the Project selection's first item (the item menu's: its own), relative to the project, then runs media.attachProxies {item, path}, as upstream's route (a file picker, no dialog); with nothing selected the status bar says "select a clip in the Project panel".

menu:Clip/Proxy/media.reconnectFullRes.note: Picks a video file through the host for the Project selection's first item (the item menu's: its own), relative to the project, then runs media.reconnectFullRes {item, path}, as upstream's route (a file picker, no dialog). Without a proxy the status bar says "the clip has no proxy attached" before the picker opens (upstream says it after).

followUps.item: Timeline clip head thumbnails redraw when proxies toggle or a file goes missing or unreadable on this host (Task 38): inspect()'s media stamp is peer-stable (the file, made offline, the proxy file), so the Timeline, which reads it, misses what only this host sees; read the host-aware stamp (project.items' media_stamp, or an extra) for the Timeline. media.toggleProxies bumps the revision (bump_view), so the Project panel re-reads project.items and redraws; a file found missing or unreadable (a rescan, a failed decode) bumps none, so neither panel redraws until the next revision.

menu:File/Get Media File Properties for/.note: File…: the person picks a media file through the host (host/pick, as File ▸ Import; the media types only), named relative to the project, and upstream's Properties opens on file.mediaPropertiesFile's answer for it (menu_dialogs.rs route). menu:File/Project Settings/file.projectS.note: Opens upstream's Project Settings (menu_dialogs.rs defaults/show/run for project.settings; dialogs/menu.ts) on its General tab (Ingest Settings… on its Ingest tab), read from the engine (dialogDefaults): "Project: <name>", General's Renderer, Video and Audio Display Format, Capture Format, and the Title and Action Safe Areas (horizontal and vertical, 0 to 50 %), and Ingest's Ingest and Action.
